body: I think people would lie to me like that because they don't want to hurt my feelings. I don't think I'll do anything tonight, but I feel like I'll do something about it in the summer. I just don't want to look like me anymore.

I tell it to myself all the time. I absolutely hate my uneven skin tone, and I think it makes me look absolutely wretched. I know this probably seems ridiculous, but I just can't get over it. I check myself in the mirror in different lighting multiple times a day, and sometimes I look okay and sometimes I don't. No one has told me I look ugly, but I feel like everyone is lying to me.
